Learn how to face unusual pieces by defeating the [[Dwarf]] polymock player.

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Defeat [[Grulhammer Silverfist]] in a game of [[Polymock]] at [[Umbral Grotto]].
* See Hoff [Polymock Master] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* [[Fire Elemental Polymock Piece]]
*{{skill icon|Summon Ruby Djinn}}

==Walkthrough==
Grulhammer's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
#[[Dredge Form|Dredge]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Ice Spear}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Icy Bonds}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Mind Freeze}}
#[[Dolyak Rider Form|Dolyak Rider]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Smite}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Banish}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Bane Signet}}
#[[Dwarven Arcanist Form|Dwarven Arcanist]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Stone Daggers}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Sandstorm}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Earthquake}}

*Use the [[Kappa Polymock Piece]] or [[Aloe Seed Polymock Piece]] against [[Dredge Form]]
**Start casting Polymock Smite Hex when you see him using Polymock Icy Bonds. This will remove his hex just in time.
*Use the [[Earth Elemental Polymock Piece]] against [[Dolyak Rider Form]]
*Use the [[Ice Elemental Polymock Piece]] (or [[Ice Imp Polymock Piece]] if you haven't got the Ice Elemental piece yet) against [[Dwarven Arcanist Form]]

Against the Dwarven Arcanist Form it is best to stand close to him at first, and when he casts sandstorm you have just enough space to walk backwards out of the AoE.
